notes_for_editor: The register is the only detailed source. The Cerro Alto page supports only the 1973 end of the Cerro Alto tower; the register does not date the cab's move, so the story does not link the two dates. The 1933 build year is the register's Built field, and 1977 is treated as the cab replacement. The water tank, vault and microwave tower come from notes marked MVT 10/91 and may no longer stand; no newer source was read. The 'restricted' access level is our reading of 'not open to the public'; the register does not use that word. No staffing names or fires were found, so none are recorded. Search results (archive.org and californiarevealed) show photographs of the lookout dated August 1953, August 1956 and May 1958 in a California forestry collection; not used because reuse terms were not checked. A 1968 county board item mentions a Bureau of Land Management letter about the Rocky Butte lookout; not used because it does not say what the letter concerned.
